spec.description: AgentRegistryServiceSpec defines the desired state of AgentRegistryService

agentSpec.description: Optional. The spec of the Agent. When `agent_spec` is set, the type of the service is Agent.

content.description: Optional. The content of the Agent spec in the JSON format. This payload is validated against the schema for the specified type. The content size is limited to `10KB`.

type.description: Required. The type of the agent spec content.

description.description: Optional. User-defined description of an Service. Can have a maximum length of `2048` characters.

displayName.description: Optional. User-defined display name for the Service. Can have a maximum length of `63` characters.

endpointSpec.description: Optional. The spec of the Endpoint. When `endpoint_spec` is set, the type of the service is Endpoint.

content.description: Optional. The content of the endpoint spec. Reserved for future use.

type.description: Required. The type of the endpoint spec content.

interfaces.description: Optional. The connection details for the Service.

protocolBinding.description: Required. The protocol binding of the interface.

location.description: The location that this resource belongs to.

mcpServerSpec.description: Optional. The spec of the MCP Server. When `mcp_server_spec` is set, the type of the service is MCP Server.

content.description: Optional. The content of the MCP Server spec. This payload is validated against the schema for the specified type. The content size is limited to `10KB`.

type.description: Required. The type of the MCP Server spec content.

projectRef.description: The Project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The AgentRegistryService name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

status.description: AgentRegistryServiceStatus defines the config connector machine state of AgentRegistryService

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

registryResource.description:
Output only. The resource name of the resulting Agent, MCP Server, or
 Endpoint. Format:

 * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/mcpServers/{mcp_server}`
 * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/agents/{agent}`
 * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/endpoints/{endpoint}`
